briefings.title: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan Talks Trading Revenue, AI Safety | Bloomberg Talks
briefings.tldr: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan expects third-quarter trading revenue to be relatively flat compared to an exceptionally strong prior year, while warning that the rapid pace of artificial intelligence development requires deliberate safety guardrails and careful corporate deployment.
